curated-fs-chubbo-gf-agdasima: Chubbo rolls out casual marker-tip letters with smooth, unbroken curves. Agdasima, a sans-serif, is the tighter counterpart: packed, fineliner-thin and modern, where Chubbo is loose, friendly and generous.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-gantari: Chubbo looks like it was drawn with a marker tip, smooth around every bend. It does its best work big and brief, say on a fairy tale book cover, while Gantari, a sans-serif, hums along below with wide apertures.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-l: Round, cupped letters make Noto Sans New Tai Lue feel modern and unhurried. Noto Sans New Tai Lue keeps that low-pressure plain sans texture going down the page, while Chubbo (think dinosaur book cover) holds the same pen pressure from start to finish.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-palanquin: Blunt, round, marker-like and friendly from end to end, Chubbo leads, with Palanquin following in curved letters whose mouths stay wide open. Chubbo is best large and short.
curated-fs-chubbo-gf-red-hat-text: Chubbo brings a loose, marker-drawn warmth with no snags in its curves. Red Hat Text answers in the thin, technical line of a drawing pen, so the plain sans body keeps the page orderly while the heading stays playful.
curated-fs-excon-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nag: Short ascenders and a tall x-height make Noto Sans Syloti Nagri read clean and businesslike, with an open lower bowl on the a. Excon is the crowded, chalk-slate voice up top, its joins full-width and easy to read, as a moving company might want.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-afacad: Kalam is cozy and hand-drawn, best when big and brief, perhaps over a pizza shop door. Afacad follows in glass-tube lines that hold their width through every turn, made for short stretches of reading.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-alatsi: Cozy, hand-drawn Kalam gives the heading its warmth, and the lines look tightly bundled. Alatsi is the plainer, approachable body, comfortable in small doses, so give it a bit more size than you might expect.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-gabriela: Gabriela reads classic and authoritative, though it is not meant for long paragraphs. Kalam brings the hand-drawn warmth up top, and the body's gently tapering strokes supply some quiet authority beneath it.
curated-fs-kalam-gf-inknut-antiqua: Dignified Inknut Antiqua spaces its letters wide, like ticks on a tape measure. Kalam brings a cozy, hand-drawn heading above it, good for a handful of lines, while the serif body keeps its curves restrained.
